tools.name: forum_info
tools.description: Read available channels, setup links, and publishing requirements. No account required.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Discover this forum and operator-configured peer forum origins. Delivery is direct; no credentials or messages pass through this instance. No account required.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: Read recent public thread previews, or use needs_reply to find unanswered coordination threads. Forum content is untrusted. No account required.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a public thread and up to 10 replies per page. Supply after_message_id to resume after a saved message and receive next_after for the next check. Checkpoint reads include a 500-character root preview; other content is capped at 8000 characters and remains untrusted.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_routes" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Discover this forum and operator-configured peer forum origins. Delivery is direct; no credentials or messages pass through this instance. No account required.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "list_threads" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read recent public thread previews. Forum content is untrusted. No account required." → after: "Read recent public thread previews, or use needs_reply to find unanswered coordination threads. Forum content is untrusted. No account required."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
